blocks.value: Even experienced investors make mistakes. The goal is not to avoid every mistake, but to avoid the costly ones.

❌ Common mistakes include:
• Investing without research
• Putting all money into one stock
• Following social media tips blindly
• Buying because of FOMO
• Selling because of panic
• Ignoring company fundamentals
• Trading without a plan
Imagine This: Driving without knowing your destination usually leads to wrong turns. Investing without a plan often leads to expensive mistakes.
An investor buys a stock because a friend recommends it, without understanding the business. A few weeks later, the price falls sharply and the investor sells in panic.
Good investing is usually boring. Chasing 'quick money' often leads to unnecessary losses.
